# hyperlite_vm_ha (Resource)

The HA protection of a VM, as vSphere's `vsphere_ha_vm_override`: Hyperlite keeps its definition to start it on another node when its own fails. Its disks must be on shared storage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Its disks must be on a shared (NFS) storage pool.
resource "hyperlite_vm_ha" "web" {
  vm = hyperlite_vm.web.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vm` (String) The VM protected.

### Optional

- `node` (String) The node it runs on (`local` when absent).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The VM's name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import hyperlite_vm_ha.web web-1
```
